problem: The Netlify production build for the pricing runtime fix failed with build exit code 2. Reproduction reached tools/prijzen-uit-de-homepage.mjs after the heavy V18 build and the process was killed before the remaining production build stages completed.
root_cause: The CLI path of tools/prijzen-uit-de-homepage.mjs executed rewrite, full site normalization/SEO work and final verification in one long-lived Node process. After preceding V18 build transforms, the process retained enough heap and module state to make the pricing-shell stage vulnerable to provider memory limits.
prevention: When invoked with BG_PRICING_STAGE=all, run rewrite, normalize and verify as separate child Node processes so memory is released between phases.
Keep the exported stage implementation unchanged so focused callers and tests can still execute a single stage in-process.
A child stage failure must fail the parent command with the failing stage, exit code and signal.
Production closure still requires the complete Netlify build plus exact production SHA and pricing/i18n browser proof.
